newsitem.title: UK: Polypipe to buy T.D.I. UK for 4.26 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Polypipe to buy T.D.I. UK for 4.26 mln stg.

text.p: Polypipe Plc, a diversified building materials company, said on Tuesday it had agreed to acquire T.D.I. UK Ltd for a maximum price of 4.26 million stg.

Polypipe said it was paying an initial consideration of 3.10 million stg for the issued capital of the company which could rise to 3.26 million stg depending on T.D.I.'s profits in the three financial years to December 31, 1999.

Polypipe would pay another 1.0 million stg to make payments for purchasing patents from some vendors. The company would raise this sum through an issue of new 416,667 Polypipe ordinary shares of 10 pence each.
